title: 第17章 你能不能正经练第18章 站不住了
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
第二天，江欲起了个大早。
她揉着肩膀推开门，一眼就看到了同样正要出门的沧溟。
沧溟显然也没想到这个从前日上三竿才肯爬起来的人居然会起这么早。
昨晚被她按在屏风上又摸又逼着呼吸的场景还历历在目，此刻那张脸一出现在视线里，他腰腹间的皮肤就莫名其妙地开始发烫。
他迅速收回视线，脚步一转装作没看见江欲，径直朝后山方向走去。
“沧溟，你去哪里？”
江欲的声音从他身后追上来，听到这声音沧溟脚步一顿，脊背绷得笔直。
他抿了抿唇没有回头，继续往前迈了一步，可江欲比他快，只是瞬间那道宽厚的影子就挡在了他面前。
他不得不停下，视线扫过她光滑了不少的脸颊，最后撞上那双黑沉沉的眸子。
那双眼睛正紧紧盯着他，像盯着自己势在必得的猎物一般。
“怎么不回答我？”江欲仰着头问。
“……与你无关。”
过了好半天，沧溟终于挤出四个字。
江欲当然不会被这么没有杀伤力的话吓到，不但没让反而又往前凑了半寸。
“昨晚你还没回答我呢。”她歪了歪头放轻了声音，笑眯眯的开口，“我的呼吸法，是不是很管用？”
沧溟的耳朵彻底红透了。
他想反驳江欲用的肯定是什么歪门邪道，还这么霸道的强迫了自己，简直是个流氓。
可身体昨晚那种舒畅感还记忆犹新，每一寸经脉都在恬不知耻地怀念那股清凉的灌注。
他昨天晚上甚至偷偷试过自己复现那种呼吸，却无论如何都达不到同样的效果。
“不说话就是默认了。”江欲满意地弯起嘴角，“但是满意了也要付出一点代价的。”

“什么代价？”
沧溟听到这话皱眉看着面前的人，还以为她又要趁机要求自己做什么取悦她的事情。
“代价嘛……”江欲已经自顾自地迈开了步子，身影还是和从前一样肥胖，但是和从前的自卑不一样，而是带着几分轻松，“你不是经常去后山练刀，肯定很会这方面的练习。”
“我最近突然觉得自己好像有些太胖了，想要减减肥。”
“你就来当我的教练吧。”
沧溟一愣。
“教练？”他皱眉，有些不理解这个从她嘴里蹦出来的词语，“那是什么东西？”
“就是……”
江欲挠了挠头，似乎在组织语言：“就是师傅！！”
沧溟听到这个词有些惊奇的看着面前的人，曾经的江欲自认为是最有天赋的人，就算是后来修为停滞了也从来都不屑于请教别人。
现在师傅这个词居然会从她嘴里说出来，让沧溟觉得江欲确实是有了很多的改变。
他上下打量了一眼江欲，虽然江欲确实是谦虚了几分，但是就她那个吃不了苦的性子，能坚持三天就算太阳打西边出来了。
“随你。”
沧溟收回视线，语气淡淡的：“到时候别喊累。”
听到这话江欲立马开心一拍胸脯，震得衣服都抖了三抖：“当然不会，有这么帅的师傅教我肯定不会累的。”
content_en:
The next day, Jiang Yu got up early.
She rubbed her shoulders and opened the door, and immediately saw Cangming who was also about to go out.
Cangming obviously didn't expect that this person who used to climb three poles a day would get up so early.
The scene of him being pressed against the screen, touching and forcing him to breathe last night was still vivid in his mind. As soon as that face came into view, the skin on his waist and abdomen began to feel hot inexplicably.
He quickly looked away, turned his steps, pretended not to see Jiang Yu, and walked straight towards the back mountain.
"Cangming, where are you going?"
Jiang Yu's voice caught up with him from behind. Hearing this voice, Cangming's steps stopped and his back straightened.
He pursed his lips and didn't look back, and continued to take a step forward, but Jiang Yu was faster than him, and the generous shadow blocked him in an instant.
He had to stop, his eyes swept over her smoother cheeks, and finally hit those dark eyes.
Those eyes were staring at him tightly, as if they were staring at the prey they were bound to win.
"Why don't you answer me?" Jiang Yu asked, raising his head.
"...It has nothing to do with you."
After a long time, Cangming finally squeezed out four words.
Of course Jiang Yu would not be frightened by such innocuous words. Instead of giving in, he moved forward half an inch.
"You didn't answer me last night." She tilted her head, lowered her voice, and said with a smile, "Is my breathing method very effective?"
Cangming's ears were completely red.
He wanted to refute what Jiang Yu was using, but he must have used some crooked method, and yet he forced himself to do so in such a domineering manner. He was simply a hooligan.
But the feeling of comfort in my body last night is still fresh in my memory, and every inch of my meridians shamelessly misses that cool infusion.
He even secretly tried to reproduce that kind of breathing last night, but he couldn't achieve the same effect.
"If you don't speak, you are acquiescing." Jiang Yu curled his lips with satisfaction, "But if you are satisfied, you have to pay a price."
"What price?"
When Cangming heard this, he frowned and looked at the person in front of him, thinking that she was going to take the opportunity to ask him to do something to please her again.
"What's the price..." Jiang Yu had already taken steps on his own, his figure was still as fat as before, but it was different from the inferiority complex before, and he was a little relaxed, "You don't often go to the back mountain to practice swordsmanship, you must be good at this aspect of practice."
"I suddenly feel like I'm a little too fat recently and want to lose weight."
"You can be my coach."
Cangming was stunned.
"Coach?" He frowned, not understanding the word that came out of her mouth. "What is that?"
"That's it..."
Jiang Yu scratched his head and seemed to be organizing his words: "That's the master!!"
Cangming looked at the person in front of him in surprise when he heard this word. Jiang Yu used to think that he was the most talented person. Even though his cultivation later stagnated, he never bothered to ask others for advice.
Now that the word master came out of her mouth, Cangming felt that Jiang Yu had indeed changed a lot.
He looked Jiang Yu up and down. Although Jiang Yu was indeed a bit humble, she had a temperament that couldn't bear hardships. If she could persist for three days, the sun would rise in the west.
"As you wish."
Cangming looked away and said calmly: "Don't complain about being tired when the time comes."
When Jiang Yu heard this, he immediately slapped his chest happily, shaking his clothes three times: "Of course not. I will definitely not be tired if I have such a handsome master to teach me."
